snippet.title: 1001 Hugs // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/1157020/1001_Hugs/

Kid friendly action game - to bring Christmas presents to Santa. For a low poly 3D shooter it has a unique gameplay. You have to hug key elves and deal with mischief ones to pass through levels. 

Developed by 
Aigul Aubanova
